DARV.talk.RAS_FOR_STS2_CHARACTER_XILA_CH: Your gem... it sparkles. It's the color of moonlight.
Moonlight? Haha, little girl, my gems are worth far more than moonlight!
Back again? I remember you! The little bunny carrying a sword bigger than herself!
What are you looking for? Among my treasures, is there something you want?
...I'm looking for something that can make the sword sharper.
Sharper? Haha! You've come to the right place! Pick one—I'll give you a discount!
NEOW.talk.RAS_FOR_STS2_CHARACTER_XILA_CH: [sine]...Go... to the spire... swing your sword...[/sine]
[sine]...As you wish... Moonlight... will walk with you...[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.RAS_FOR_STS2_CHARACTER_XI: My, the little bunny has good taste! Accept my blessing, you'll be even prettier!
You and your big sword both need new clothes! Come, let me dress you up!
Even carrying such a big sword, you remain elegant. Come, let me add a touch of brilliance to you.
...I only need the sword to be sharp enough.
My my, what a spoilsport! Take it—let your sword shine too!
OROBAS.talk.RAS_FOR_STS2_CHARACTER_XILA_: Of course rabbits jump high!! Let's fight!!
Big sword little bunny!! Again again! I haven't seen enough!!
You look so cool with that sword!! Here, take this!!
You're welcome, you're welcome!! Call my name next time you swing your sword!!
PAEL.talk.RAS_FOR_STS2_CHARACTER_XILA_CH: Are you sleeping?... Can I sit next to you?
[thinky_dots]Hmm... sit down... the moonlight is soft...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Little bunny... the sword is heavy, isn't it... rest a while...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Take a part of me... so you can sleep more peacefully under the moonlight...[/thinky_dots]
I'm not afraid of pain. Only afraid of... the sword becoming dull.
[thinky_dots]Silly child... a dull sword can be sharpened... but a tired person needs rest...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.RAS_FOR_STS2_CHARACTER_XILA_CH: [b]Of course!! But can your small frame even lift it?![/b]
[b]Here to challenge again?! Good!! Let me see how sharp your sword is!![/b]
[b]Little bunny!! Fight me!! Prove your strength with your big sword!![/b]
...I'm not here to fight. Just passing through.
[b]Coward!! But your eyes are determined!! Take this power!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.RAS_FOR_STS2_CHARACTER_XI: Your little rabbit ears are all red from the cold, come warm yourself by the fire~
Back again~ Is the big sword polished? Come, let me help you sharpen it~
Dear, try my [jitter][b]moonlight cookies[/b][/jitter]~ They're not good when cold.
...Thank you. But I can't eat food from strangers.
My, quite cautious aren't you~ Then let me give you this power, as a meeting gift~
VAKUU.talk.RAS_FOR_STS2_CHARACTER_XILA_C: Are you a demon?... Your horns are beautiful.
Oh? Praising my horns? Interesting little bunny. What do you want?
You're back. Every time you come carrying that heavy sword... aren't you tired?
Let me see... your soul has the taste of moonlight. I can give you power—at the cost of [sine]a little bit of ear[/sine], how about it?
Not the ears. Anything else is fine.
Haha! What a lovely persistence. Fine—take this power, I'll think about what I want next time.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.RAS_FOR_STS2_CHARACTE: Little bunny, why did you come here? To become stronger? For revenge? Or... to find someone?
...I just want to reach the top of the spire. To see the moonlight there.
Moonlight at the top of the spire? Foolish. At the top of the spire, there is only [red]me[/red].
You failed again. Still not giving up?
The sword isn't broken yet, I won't give up.
...Interesting. Then continue. Let me see how far you can go.
You keep coming back, just for that ethereal moonlight?
Moonlight isn't ethereal. It's always been there.
...Fine. Then prove it with your sword—whether the moonlight is worth chasing like this.
